_readme: The repo list is now fetched automatically from GitHub. Only add an entry to this file when a project needs a special setting that differs from the generic (auto-detected) behavior. Key = must exactly match the GitHub repo name. If secretManager is '1password', op://vault/item/field references inside .env.example are filled in with real values via 'op inject' (the 1Password CLI must be installed and signed in); otherwise .env.example is copied as-is. If healthCheckPort is given, after 'docker compose up' the tool waits until that port starts listening; if not given, the first published port in docker-compose.yml is auto-detected. For projects that don't require Docker, if runCommand is given (e.g. 'npm run start:dev') that command is run in the background after setup; if not given, the dev/start/serve script in package.json is used, then for Laravel projects (if an artisan file exists) 'php artisan serve', and if none of those apply, a safe command (starting with npm/yarn/pnpm) found in README.md. If runPort is given, that port is health-checked directly instead of guessing it from logs. In postCloneCommands auto-detection, 'composer install' is also added if composer.json exists (it can coexist with npm/yarn/pnpm in the same repo).

web-app.readyMessage: Web app is ready! Check it out at http://localhost:3000.

airalo-partner-panel-frontend.readyMessage: Partner Panel is ready! Check it out at http://localhost:5173.

test-task.readyMessage: Up and running via Docker! Check it out at http://localhost:8080.

postCloneCommands: export COMPOSER_AUTH="{\"github-oauth\":{\"github.com\":\"$(gh auth token)\"}}" && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose run --rm -e COMPOSER_AUTH php composer install
docker compose run --rm php php artisan key:generate --force && docker compose run --rm php php artisan jwt:secret --force

docker compose up -d partners_mysql && until docker compose exec -T partners_mysql mysqladmin ping -h localhost -u root --silent 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && docker compose run --rm php ./artisan migrate:fresh --force
docker compose run --rm php php artisan passport:install --force
docker compose run --rm php php artisan db:seed --force
airalo-partner-backend.readyMessage: Docker build + composer install (including private airalo/*) + key:generate + jwt:secret + DB migrate + passport:install + db:seed completed. The app is genuinely running now (713 routes registered, DB/cache/rate-limit working) -- try: curl -H 'Host: partners.airalo.local' http://localhost:8081/internal/v1/health . Because some .env.example fields were empty (VIEW_COMPILED_PATH, AWS_SQS_VERSION, ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES, TRANSLATION_DRIVER, BCRYPT_ROUNDS, JWT_ALGO, INTERNAL_HEALTH_CHECK_RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITER_CACHE_DRIVER -- the last two were set to 'file' since no redis service exists in the compose file) they were auto-filled locally; this is a genuine gap in the real Airalo backend's .env.example, worth reporting to the team. The /internal/v1/health endpoint requires AIRALO_URL (a real Airalo API address), which was left empty since that value is unknown and shouldn't be guessed -- fill it in for the health-check to fully work.
